  • Field Details

    • VERSION

      public static final int VERSION
      Runtime protocol version understood by the framework and in-server agent.

      Increment this whenever the agent wire format, command set, or response semantics change in a backward-incompatible way. Both the framework and the agent must agree on this value; a mismatch causes an HANDSHAKE failure.

      public static final long DEFAULT_SYNC_OPERATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
      Default maximum time, in seconds, the agent waits for a scheduled synchronous server operation before reporting TIMEOUT. Shared so the client can derive a strictly larger response timeout.

    • CLIENT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MARGIN_MILLIS

      public static final long CLIENT_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MARGIN_MILLIS
      Safety margin, in milliseconds, added to the agent-side operation timeout to derive the client's response timeout. Guarantees the agent reports its own detailed TIMEOUT before the client watchdog gives up.
